questions.stem:
Three capacitors of capacitances $2
\mu\mathrm{F}$, $3
\mu\mathrm{F}$ and $6
\mu\mathrm{F}$ are connected in series to a $10
\mathrm{V}$ source. The charge (in $\mu\mathrm{C}$) on the $3
\mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor is:
questions.solution:
Equivalent capacitance in series: $1/C_{eq} = 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/6 = 1 \implies C_{eq} = 1
\mu\mathrm{F}$.
Total charge $Q = C_{eq} V = 1
\mu\mathrm{F} \times 10
\mathrm{V} = 10
\mu\mathrm{C}$.
In series connection, the charge on each capacitor is same as the total charge, so the charge on the $3
\mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor is $10
\mu\mathrm{C}$.

questions.stem: Three capacitors of capacitances $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, $3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ and $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ are connected in series to a $10\ \mathrm{V}$ source. The charge on the $3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor is ______ $\mu\mathrm{C}$.
questions.solution:
In a series combination, the charge $Q$ on each capacitor is the same.
The equivalent capacitance $C_{eq}$ is:
$1/C_{eq} = 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/6 = (3+2+1)/6 = 1\ \mu\mathrm{F}^{-1} \implies C_{eq} = 1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$.
The total charge from the source is $Q = C_{eq} V = 1\ \mu\mathrm{F} \times 10\ \mathrm{V} = 10\ \mu\mathrm{C}$.
Thus, the charge on the $3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor is $10\ \mu\mathrm{C}$.

questions.stem: Three capacitors of capacitances $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, $3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ and $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ are connected in series to a $10\ \mathrm{V}$ source. The charge on the $3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor is ______ $\mu\mathrm{C}$.
questions.solution:
In series, equivalent capacitance $1/C_{eq} = 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/6 = 1 \implies C_{eq} = 1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$.
Total charge $Q = C_{eq} V = 1\ \mu\mathrm{F} \times 10\ \mathrm{V} = 10\ \mu\mathrm{C}$.
Since they are in series, the charge on each capacitor, including the $3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor, is $10\ \mu\mathrm{C}$.

questions.stem: A parallel plate capacitor with plate area $A$ and plate separation $d$ is filled with two dielectrics of dielectric constants $K_1 = 3$ and $K_2 = 6$. The boundary between the two dielectrics is parallel to the plates, and each dielectric occupies half of the volume. If the effective capacitance of this capacitor is $C$, and the capacitance without any dielectric is $C_0$, then the ratio $C/C_0$ is ____________.
questions.solution:
Since the boundary is parallel to the plates, the system is a series combination of two capacitors.
Each has plate area $A$ and thickness $d/2$.
$C_1 = \frac{K_1 \varepsilon_0 A}{d/2} = 2K_1 C_0 = 6 C_0$.
$C_2 = \frac{K_2 \varepsilon_0 A}{d/2} = 2K_2 C_0 = 12 C_0$.
$C = \frac{C_1 C_2}{C_1 + C_2} = \frac{6 \times 12}{6 + 12} C_0 = 4 C_0$.
Thus, $C/C_0 = 4$.

questions.stem: Three identical capacitors each of capacitance $C$ are connected in series. This combination is connected in parallel with another series combination of two identical capacitors each of capacitance $C$. The equivalent capacitance of the entire system is:
questions.solution:
Equivalent capacitance of three identical capacitors of capacitance $C$ in series is $C_1 = C/3$. 
Equivalent capacitance of two identical capacitors of capacitance $C$ in series is $C_2 = C/2$. 
These two combinations are connected in parallel, so the overall equivalent capacitance is: 
$C_{\mathrm{eq}} = C_1 + C_2 = \frac{C}{3} + \frac{C}{2} = \frac{5}{6} C$.

questions.stem: Three capacitors of capacitances $2\ \mu\text{F}$, $3\ \mu\text{F}$ and $6\ \mu\text{F}$ are connected in series to a $10\text{ V}$ source. The charge on the $3\ \mu\text{F}$ capacitor is __________ $\mu\text{C}$.
questions.solution:
For series combination, $\frac{1}{C_{eq}} = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{6} = \frac{3+2+1}{6} = 1\ \mu\text{F}^{-1} \implies C_{eq} = 1\ \mu\text{F}$.
Total charge $Q = C_{eq} V = 1\ \mu\text{F} \times 10\text{ V} = 10\ \mu\text{C}$.
Since they are in series, the charge on each capacitor, including the $3\ \mu\text{F}$ capacitor, is $10\ \mu\text{C}$.

questions.stem: Three identical capacitors each of capacitance $C$ are connected in series. This combination is connected in parallel with another series combination of two identical capacitors of capacitance $C$. The equivalent capacitance of the whole system is:
questions.solution:
Equivalent capacitance of three capacitors in series is $C_1 = \frac{C}{3}$.
Equivalent capacitance of two capacitors in series is $C_2 = \frac{C}{2}$.
These two combinations are connected in parallel, so the final equivalent capacitance is:
$C_{\text{eq}} = C_1 + C_2 = \frac{C}{3} + \frac{C}{2} = \frac{5}{6}C$.

questions.stem:
In the given circuit, the equivalent capacitance between the terminals $A$ and $B$ is _________ $\mu\text{F}$.

(The circuit consists of five capacitors each of capacitance $4\mu\text{F}$ arranged in a bridge network where the central capacitor is connected between the nodes of two parallel branches, making a balanced Wheatstone bridge).
questions.solution: For a balanced Wheatstone bridge with five identical capacitors each of value $C = 4\mu\text{F}$, the equivalent capacitance across the main terminals is simply equal to $C$. Thus, $C_{eq} = 4\mu\text{F}$.
